Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: proposal illustration for COghe, a real Unity URP mobile hybrid casual puzzle game. This is an art-direction study, NOT a screenshot of an implemented shader.
Input 1 (07-start.png) is the real game's layout, object identity and camera reference. Input 2 is only a supporting reference showing the clear closed glass enclosure and the dark liquid creature crawling on glass.
Create a refined, attractive portrait concept board. Top 75%: a large legible three-quarter gameplay-style view inside the SAME thin-framed enclosed glass cube as reference 1, with its two raised ivory work platforms, lower ivory connecting step/bridge, suspended pulley wheels and taut thin cables, small amber winch/control at front left, a rear wall control, a circular mint exit aperture in the glass rear wall, a vertical translucent lavender slick strip and coated platform faces. Keep these elements in the same relative layout as reference; no additional gameplay pieces or nonsensical gears. Keep the creature on the front floor, slightly larger in visual readability but not giant. Glass remains see-through, floor blue-grey, mechanisms comprehensible, clear holes stay open. Small ivory plastic plaque marked "07" is directly attached to the front glass under the rail, not floating or clipped above it. Connections are slender printed coloured circuit traces on real supporting planes; pulley cables are real taut ropes, not circuit graphics.
The creature is the EXISTING COghe: a dark navy-charcoal liquid blob, squat asymmetrical body with several small soft tendrils, TWO small expressive white cartoon eyes with dark pupils, curious pose, one short tendril raised. No permanent head, legs, ears, fur, teeth, tongue, costume or redesign into another animal. It must look like cohesive deformable living liquid, not a pile of balls. Keep the body dark with broad readable highlights.
Bottom 25%: three clean small close-up swatches of the exact same design: curious COghe pose; warm ivory mechanism with coloured actionable handle and thin printed circuit; clear glass with a bounded pastel lavender slick coating beside a mint flush exit. These are art details, not extra scene objects. English headings only, no invented game HUD or level selector. Warm cream and faint desaturated mint lab-silhouette background, sparse and clean, no text clutter. No dramatic volumetric lighting, raytraced caustics, realistic refraction, complex environment reflection or dense decorations. Target an achievable in-engine mobile game look.
VARIANT A, headline exactly "A · SOFT TOON LAB", small subtitle "COghe / Cartoon shader study". Soft three-tone cel shading with gently blended transitions, rounded existing edge bevels, warm ivory equipment, blue-grey supporting rails. Rich controlled pastel accents, small glossy highlights on dark jelly, subtle rim light on COghe, soft modest directional shadows. Glass has just a few restrained painted reflection streaks and a thin tinted edge, unobstructed view. No dark line around every object. Look polished, cute, calm, tangible and distinctly cartoon shaded rather than washed-out physically realistic rendering. The creature's eyes and gesture convey affection. Keep functional coloured pieces identifiable, not all mint. No opaque toybox walls.
